text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, bust, waist,
and hip… with no additions! 
And no color preference written down in the
remarks!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup, if we keep this pace up we should be
able to finish everything by this evening!
Thank goodness! 
But it's actually quite difficult to be a
costume checker, huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The only person left is Yukippe,
right? She said she'd be 
waiting for us around here,
but I don't see her anywhere…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Umm… I'm right here… The outfit fits well…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Oh it's you,
Yukino-san! You look absolutely amazing! 
I thought an idol was coming to talk to us
for a moment there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No no, I don't look like an idol! But anyways,
I'm really sorry 
for calling you two out all the way here.
This outfit is kind of 
embarrassing and I didn't want too many
people to see it…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why not!? Yukippe,
you look adorable!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no,
no! This outfit's way too revealing! 
You can see my legs and stomach!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I keep checking behind me to make sure no
one's looking. 
Th-Then there's the upcoming live
performance…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is there something bothering 
you about the live performance?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-Well… I heard that a lot of people from
my 
hometown bought tickets to the
performance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I'm just so nervous! 
And to add onto that, this outfit…
(BOM BOM BOM BOM…!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oryaaaa! I'm not going to lose this, 
I've got the entirety of Oi pushing me
forward!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's so many people that helped me along
the way too! 
Tome-san, Shige-san, Chiyo-san, and Yoshi-san,
I can still 
see their smiles!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you and I are really similar,
huh!? That means there 
ain't no way I'ma lose now!
Feel the spirit of Oi!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll show you the spirit of
Kasamatsu!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Oguri
text_block_list.text:
Huwaaaaaahh!! 
Waaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Woah! The beach sand turned into a cloud 
of dust!! Ah,
I can't even see them anymore!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The spirit of Oi and the spirit of
Kasamatsu. 
I see,
so those two came from the countryside too,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah!
There's so many people and so many stalls!
Tamaya!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm so excited! I see takoyaki,
cotton candy, 
and chocolate bananas!
Where should we start?♪

text_block_list.name: Festival Organising ...
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
I'm glad to see you girls are enjoying
yourselves! Oh, my bad.
I'm part of the preparation committee for
this festival.
Are you girls on a summer training camp?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yup, you're right!
But we're taking a break for today. 
It's really lively here today, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Festival Organising ...
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
we've been preparing for this festival for
the past year. 
But it wasn't just the preparation committee,
the entire 
community came out in droves to help.

text_block_list.name: Festival Organising ...
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing to see this normally quiet
place come to life again. 
I hope you guys will enjoy yourself before
you head back home!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Of course we will!
Hehe… this is so strange. 
Even though I've never been here,
everything feels so nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I feel like Kochi's festivals also had
a similar feeling to them!
Everyone would dance in beautiful clothing
and 
everything felt so warm.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido was the same way!
We usually have a bon odori 
festival around this time of year.
The excitement and warmth 
during that festival was just like this
one!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You can really feel the love and care put
into those festivals. 
They also help to reignite the fire in the
community…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's right… Giving back to the
community…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I… wish I could give back to my hometown…
I hope that 
my performances and races will help to get
them excited!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just like the people hosting this festival
and Inari-san and 
Oguri-san,
they're all carrying their hometowns on
their backs!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
I've made up my mind!
I'm going to stop being afraid! 
In the upcoming performance I'm going to
dance my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Spe & Urara
text_block_list.text: Woah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to enter a race near my
hometown! 
I'm going to make it super exciting, win,
and show 
them an amazing performance afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like a great idea! 
I should go back home and do the same!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Woah,
really!? Well I won't be left out on this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting so excited!
I'll be in Morioka, 
Spe-san will be in Hokkaido,
and Urara-san will be in Kochi!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We're all carrying the hopes and dreams of
our hometowns on our shoulders!
We'll show them an amazing race, 
an amazing victory,
and an amazing performance afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We'll repay them for all they've done for
us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I really like your spirit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Inari-san and Oguri-san!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But if yer really gonna do it,
you better not 
give up the spotlight to anyone.
If you're not prepared to do that,
it ain't gonna be fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up the spotlight to anyone…!? 
I don't think I'll be able to… 
No, no, that's the wrong mind set!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't let anyone steal my spotlight! 
I'm the star of Morioka after all!
(fshuuu… BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Perfect timing,
huh? Gotta love it. 
But Oguri, we can't let them one up us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If the next generation's gonna be so
determined, 
we're gonna have to grow stronger too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're right… We'll need to 
show them that we're not finished yet!
